title: The uncle at the saw
logline: Gully's uncle at the head saw in 1994, from the side, the blade a black disc, the cedar coming through in a plane of ochre, sawdust as spotting. The man who will hand over the keys, working.

panels.composition: The mill floor: a broad man in a canvas jacket at the head saw from the side, the blade a black disc, a cedar cant coming through in a plane of ochre, sawdust falling as black spots. Windows behind, gray.

characters.pose: at the head saw, from the side
